limitations: Novelty is approximate and calibrated against validation-to-training distances.
Distance maps do not establish physical stability or designability.
The deprecated edm_compatible field is a permissive heuristic, not strict EDM validity.
principal_conclusion: The current model produces numerically valid, non-duplicated, length-conditioned distance-like matrices and approximates several local distributional properties, but its generated matrices do not lie on the empirical manifold of real three-dimensional protein distance matrices. Global geometric inconsistency and excess compactness worsen with sequence length.
